title: From AI prototype to Play Store ready game
author: ineedthealgorithm
selftext:
I recently put together a small mobile game using AI with [Pixelfork](https://www.pixelfork.ai/) and ended up with a Play Store-ready build.

You can play the game here: [https://www.pixelfork.ai/publish/35167c97-998d-4ba8-9808-fbe4ce17df77](https://www.pixelfork.ai/publish/35167c97-998d-4ba8-9808-fbe4ce17df77)

What I liked most was how straightforward the whole process felt. I could quickly export an APK, install it on my phone, tweak things, and once everything's done, switch to an AAB for publishing.

It didn’t feel like the usual “prototype that never ships” loop. More like actually getting something ready to release without a ton of friction.

It really feels like this closes the gap between *“I have an idea”* and *“this is on the Play Store.”*
